flags.message: This docket (25-566) was consolidated into Viramontes v. Cook County, No. 25-238, at the 2026-06-30 grant, and the docket's own final entry says all future filings and activity will be reflected on 25-238's docket. The merits judgment may therefore never appear as an entry here — outcome resolution for this event will likely need to read the lead docket.
